name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add ComfyUI’s SD3.5 Medium RealVisXL LoRA to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It’s the fastest way to boost image quality without slowing the pipeline—RealVisXL’s realism and SD3.5’s speed give a measurable 0.5%+ lift in usable output. The trade-off is extra VRAM usage, but we’re already running on beefy GPUs; the net gain outweighs the cost.

name: Torque
text: RealVisXL’s realism won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—faces blur worse under its heavy upscaling. Instead, test InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler first; it preserves facial detail better and runs lighter. Run a blind A/B test on 100 faces—if InstantX’s faces score higher in clarity, it’s the better 0.5% lift.
